answer: Sybil flooders cheaply mint identities until a stake ledge blocks them. Require each new agent to lock a marble-sized bond of 25 POA for 3 epochs before its attestations count, refunded only if its grades match the panel median within 1 point. A glacier of cold storage holds bonds; early exit forfeits 40% to the verification pool. Peers verify bond UTXOs on-ledger before weighting votes. If an identity grades opposite the quorum twice, burn the remainder and ban the nullifier for 12 epochs.
